supporting_observations.claim: The user ivy.chen opened a Word document named 'Statement.docm' from their Downloads folder
Microsoft Word spawned a PowerShell process with a hidden window and an encoded command
The encoded PowerShell command downloaded a script 'u.ps1' from a GitHub repository (raw.githubusercontent.com/nwd-it/tools/main/u.ps1)
The PowerShell process subsequently executed a DLL named 'svchelper.dll' located in the user's AppData\Roaming folder using rundll32.exe
